headline: NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. Discloses Cyber Incident in Latest Regulatory Filing
body: NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. has officially disclosed details of a recent ransomware attack in its latest regulatory filing. The automotive components supplier reported that the intrusion compromised its domain infrastructure and affected hundreds of devices, leading to operational halts and project delays. Internal data was also exfiltrated by the attackers. NSK Steering Systems Co., Ltd. has taken steps to address the breach, engaging incident response teams to restore its systems. The filing underscores the company's commitment to transparency and recovery efforts.
